Saved. The list is off: every incoming call except emergency numbers.

The audio helper is stopped and the local key is deleted. The key on the phone was not removed. In Settings, Developer options, Wireless debugging, forget the paired device and turn wireless debugging off.
This app handles the phone\'s calls.
Needed to place and answer calls.
Allowed. On Vivo, also set Battery, then Background power consumption, to Allow for OpenLine.
Without this the phone drops off the gateway after a few minutes.
Open Settings, then Apps, then OpenLine, then Battery
Scan the QR code shown in the admin console.
Call audio is running on its own. Wireless debugging can be turned off.

Call audio is running only while this app keeps the Wireless debugging session open. Leave Wireless debugging on. Turning it off stops call audio. On this Android the audio process does not survive a closed debugging session.
Stopped. Connect to a Wi-Fi network once to start it; mobile data is fine after that.
Wi-Fi is on, but the phone isn\'t connected to a network yet.

OpenLine starts its call-audio helper through Android\'s Wireless debugging, which only runs while the phone is connected to a Wi-Fi network. Join any network for a moment (a hotspot from another phone works too). After that, calls work on mobile data until the phone restarts.
Open Settings and turn on Wi-Fi
This phone doesn\'t let apps become the default phone app
Turn on Wireless debugging, tap \"Pair device with pairing code\", then use the notification
Open Settings, Developer options, Wireless debugging
This code is not from the OpenLine console (https and a fingerprint are required)
Enter a full wss:// address with a host. Empty addresses, spaces, and broken brackets are not saved.
Device ID must contain only ASCII characters.
Audio goes to the gateway. This phone stays silent.
Open Settings › Developer options › Wireless debugging › Pair device with pairing code
Pairing service not found yet; keep the pairing dialog open.
Call audio ready. You can close Settings.
Paired. Call audio stays up only while Wireless debugging stays on. Leave it on.
Pairing was not accepted. Try again.
Paired. Connect to a Wi-Fi network to start call audio.

Pairing timed out. Tap Set up again in the app.
Pairing service found. Tap \"Enter code\" and type the code shown in Settings.
Shown while the phone stays connected to your gateway.

%1$s called while Lina was on another call.
Calls missed while Lina was busy: %1$d. Notifications are off, so they are not shown in the notification list. Allow notifications for OpenLine.
To answer only on the line you choose, Lina needs to see your SIM and eSIM lines (permission Phone). It does not read phone numbers. Until you allow it, Lina does not answer calls.
Lina answers calls on: %1$s. Calls on other lines ring only on the phone.
This phone has more lines. Choose the one Lina answers; until then Lina does not answer calls.
The chosen line is not active (no signal, turned off or eSIM changed). Lina does not answer calls until you choose a line.
No active SIM or eSIM line. Lina does not answer calls.
Lines could not be read reliably. Lina does not answer calls.
